Blacksmith.text:
Refund policy
 Returns 
Our policy lasts 14 days. If 14 days have gone by since receiving your purchase, unfortunately we can’t offer you a refund or exchange. 
To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging. 
To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase. 
Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer. 
 Refunds (if applicable) 
Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. 
If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days. 
 Late or missing refunds (if applicable) 
If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again. 
Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted. 
Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted. 
If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at orders@blacksmith-store.com.
If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and he will find out about your return. 
 Shipping 
To return your product, head over to our Returns Portal 
You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund. 
Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you, may vary.
 We suggest using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.
 Blacksmith Store, The Woodyard, High Street, Naseby, Northamptonshire NN6 6DD

Blue Owl Workshop.text:
Refund policy
 Blue Owl accepts returns for store credit only. 
 Returns must arrive back to Blue Owl within 21 days of when the items were shipped to the recipient. To return an item, you must contact Blue Owl within 5 days of receiving the shipment for return authorization.
 Items returned to Blue Owl must have their original tags and must be free of wear, wash, damage, odor, or any other condition that would prevent them from being sold as new.
 Items sold at discount are final sale and are not subject to return. Items ordered by special request, such as pre-orders or items not regularly carried by Blue Owl are not subject to return.
 Underwear, socks, swimwear, and any type of undergarment are final sale and are not subject to return. Denim that has been hemmed, soaked, or altered in any way, even if done through Blue Owl, are not subject to return. Boots and shoes shipped outside of the USA are final sale and are not subject to return.
 RETURN PROCESS:
 Request return authorization on our   returns page .
 Ship Authorized Returns: Returns must be shipped no later than seven days of our return authorization, and must be received within 21 days of the initial order. You are responsible for all return shipping costs as well as any items lost or damaged. We recommend that you insure your package and use a service that allows you to track your package. Blue Owl will not accept a return shipped COD.
 Receive Credit/Exchange: Upon arriving at Blue Owl all items will be inspected for any signs of wear, wash, damage, odor, or any other condition that would prevent them from being sold as new. If the items are acceptable you will be contacted via email with information on the credit or exchange. Unacceptable items, including items shipped without authorization, will be returned to sender at sender's cost.
 Return Shipping Address:
Blue Owl Workshop
C/O Returns
124 NW Canal Street Ste. 1
Seattle, WA 98107

Haven.text:
Customer Support
 Orders
 Where is my order? 
 After you place your order, you’ll receive a confirmation email. Once your order is processed and packed, we’ll send a shipping confirmation with your tracking number. When your order is delivered, you’ll receive a final confirmation email.
 Where is my online order being shipped from? 
 We ship from one of our two locations: Toronto, Ontario or Vancouver, British Columbia, based on current inventory.
 In some cases, your order may ship in two separate packages.
 If your order is split, you’ll receive multiple shipping confirmation emails with tracking details for each parcel.
 I just placed an order, can I modify or cancel it? 
 Contact us as soon as possible at info@havenshop.com.
 Orders marked “Release Product” are final sale. They cannot be modified, cancelled, returned, or exchanged once submitted.
 For all other orders, our online customer service team is available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM PST, and weekends/holidays, 12 PM–5 PM PST.
 Please note: Once an order is submitted, HAVEN cannot guarantee it can be modified or cancelled before shipment.
 For In-Store Pickup orders, cancellation requests must be received before you are contacted for pickup.
 Do I need an account to make an order? 
 No, you can check out as a guest.
 Creating an account lets you track orders, view your order history, and receive updates on new releases and special promotions.
 Some promotions are available exclusively to subscribers and registered users.
 What payment methods do you accept? 
 We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, WeChat Pay, AliPay, Afterpay¹ & Sezzle².
 You can also pay for online orders with a HAVEN Gift Card.
 Please note that registration is not required in order to place an order through PayPal Express Checkout. Additionally, note that Apple Pay may be deactivated for particular product releases. WeChat Pay, Alipay, Afterpay and Sezzle options are presented at the final step of checkout.
 ¹ Split your entire online purchase into 4 interest-free payments, over 8 weeks with no impact on your credit.
 ² Split your entire online purchase into 4 interest-free payments, over 6 weeks with no impact on your credit
 Returns & Exchanges
 What is your return/exchange policy? 
 We accept full-priced, non–“Release Product” items for exchange or store credit within 7 days of receipt, or within 7 days of being contacted for In-Store Pickup.
 We do not offer refunds.
 All returned items must be unworn, with original tags and packaging attached. Returns require prior written approval and a valid Return Authorization. We cannot accept returns sent without authorization.
 Sale items, discounted merchandise, and items marked “Release Product” are final sale and not eligible for return or exchange.
 HAVEN is not responsible for lost or damaged returns in transit. We strongly recommend using a carrier that provides tracking.
 If a “Release Product” order is returned to sender due to an incomplete or invalid address, or is refused at delivery, the customer will be contacted and required to pay a re-shipping fee. No exceptions. If we are unable to reach the customer, or the re-shipping fee is declined, the order will be considered abandoned and a 25% restocking fee will be deducted from the store credit issued.
 We stand behind the quality and workmanship of all HAVEN namesake products. If a product fails due to a manufacturing or material defect, we will repair or replace it at our discretion, free of charge. This warranty does not cover damage caused by accidents, improper care, negligence, normal wear and tear, or the natural breakdown of materials and colors over time.
 For full details, please visit our Policies page: https://havenshop.com/policies/ .
 Does my store credit expire? 
 Store credit is issued in the form of a virtual gift card. This credit does not expire and can be redeemed at any HAVEN location as well as online. To redeem your credit for an online purchase, simply enter the provided gift card credentials at checkout.
 Shipping Information
 What are your shipping costs and delivery times? 
 Shipping costs are calculated based on the shipping location, shipping method and the value of your order. Estimated shipping rates and delivery times can be seen here: https://havenshop.com/shipping-rates/.
 Note that these estimates do not include order processing times or potential customs delays and that they may be subject to fluctuation throughout the year.
 Does HAVEN ship internationally? 
 HAVEN ships worldwide, with the exception of select countries.
 All orders are shipped via FedEx. In most cases, FedEx handles delivery door-to-door. Where FedEx is not available, Canada Post will be used. After clearing customs, your parcel may be transferred to your local carrier for final delivery.
 For more detailed tracking updates, we recommend checking your local carrier’s website (e.g., USPS, China Post, UK Post).
 International orders may be subject to customs duties and fees set by the destination country. These charges are determined by local authorities, and HAVEN is not responsible for any additional customs costs.
 Can I place an order online and do an in-store pickup? 
 Yes. In-store pickup is available at both our Toronto and Vancouver locations.
 Store hours: Monday–Saturday, 12 PM–7 PM; Sunday/Holiday, 12 PM–5 PM.
 To select in-store pickup, choose this option under “Shipping Method” at checkout.
 Please allow up to 7 business days for your order to be ready, as items may need to be transferred between locations. You’ll receive an email notification once your order is ready for pickup.
 At pickup, the credit card holder must present a valid government-issued photo ID (driver’s license or equivalent) and the credit card used for the transaction. No exceptions.

 How can I determine my size in a garment?

No Man Walks Alone.text:
Refund policy
 We want every customer to be fully satisfied with their purchase.
 If an item doesn’t fit or is not to your liking, we offer free exchange and easy returns on all regular price orders - no questions asked!
 What is your return policy? 
 You may return   unworn, unwashed, and undamaged items within 14 days of purchase .
 Items purchased during end-of-season sales and identified as "final sale" on the product page cannot be returned for a refund.
 There is an  $8.95 processing fee   on all   domestic returns to participate in the cost   the  return  shipping and restocking. The fee is   waived on exchanges and returns for store credit .
 For   international orders, return shipping costs are covered by the customer . Please ship your return to the address below with a copy of your order details:
 No Man Walks Alone, Attn: Returns,
141 West 36th St.  Floor 17,
New York, NY 10018.
 Alternatively, you can start your international return through the Global-e returns portal and purchase postage to ship your order back to us:    Global-e Returns Portal 
 What are acceptable returns? 
 We inspect all returned items when they arrive at our processing facility.
 You can initiate a return of an item within 14 days of purchase , and we will refund the full cost of the merchandise in the original form of payment as long as the item is unworn, unused, unwashed, unaltered and with all packaging, including the No Man Walks Alone tag still attached.
 We will not accept returns, and will not offer refunds for special order items (custom, made-to-order), underwear/hosiery, gift cards and  any final sale products. Final sale products are clearly indicated as such.
 We will not accept returns of shoes which are scuffed, scratched or otherwise show signs of wear. As such, we recommend that you try on the shoes on a carpet or other soft surface.
 In the event that any returned item is rejected, we will ship the item back to the customer.
 How do I exchange or return my order? 
 US orders: Return or exchange  via mail  -  start here :
 Start your return or exchange online to receive a mailing label to box and ship your items
 You will receive an email when your return is received and your refund has been processed.
 Please allow 1-2 business days for your refund to be initiated
 International Orders: You can start your international return through the Global-e returns portal and purchase postage to ship your order back to us:    Global-e Returns Portal 
 Alternatively, you can simply ship your return to the address below with a copy of your order details:
 No Man Walks Alone, Attn: Returns,
141 West 36th St.  Floor 17,
New York, NY 10018 (USA)
 How (and how soon) should I expect my refund? 
 Once your items have been dropped off with the return carrier, your refund will be initiated immediately. Please allow 5-7 business days for your refund to be processed by your bank.
 Can I return an item received as a gift? 
 Gift orders can be exchanged or returned for store credit only.
 Start your Gift Return online here . You will need to provide the order number and billing or shipping zip code. If you don't have it, please contact Customer Service at customer@nomanwalksalone.com for assistance.
 As soon as you return your order by mail or in-person, you'll receive an email with your store credit code
 Are there any items that cannot be returned? 
 We cannot accept returns or exchanges for items that are worn, used, washed, altered or missing their packaging or tags
 We cannot accept returns or exchanges for special order items (custom, made-to-order), underwear/hosiery, gift cards and  any final sale products. Final sale products are clearly indicated as such on their product page.
 We cannot accept returns of shoes which are scuffed, scratched or otherwise show signs of wear. As such, we recommend that you try on the shoes on a carpet or other soft surface.
 In the event that any returned item is rejected, we will ship the item back to the customer.
 I used a combination of store credit or gift certificate and credit card as payment. How will I be refunded if I return some or all of my order? 
 If you return your full order, your refunds to store credit/gift certificate and credit card will match your initial payments exactly.
 For partial returns and refunds, our system will first refund your store credit or gift certificate until the initial balance is reached , then will allocate excess refund to your credit card payment.
 Is there a limit to how much and how often I can return orders? 
 Our returns policy is flexible and generous as we want every customer to have an easy shopping experience and be fully satisfied with their purchase.    We continuously monitor the rate of returns and customers who repeatedly return orders at a rate that we consider excessive will be flagged and could, at our sole discretion, see their account terminated and/or future orders being canceled.   If this is the case with your account, we will contact you to let you know.
 Please contact No Man Walks Alone Customer Care by email at customer@nomanwalksalone.com if you have any questions.

Outlier.text:
Refund Policy
 RETURNS 
 We want you to try on and test our clothes freely without stress or worry. All items purchased on our site, unless clearly noted otherwise, can be returned for any reason for up to 17 days after the date of delivery. Return shipping in the US is free, return shipping internationally, unfortunately, is not. Just make sure the items are clean! We reserve the right to reject returns that smell or are otherwise unsanitary. 
 We also reserve the right to take away return privileges from customers we deem to engage in a pattern of excessive and/or abusive returns. 
 Please visit our RETURNS PAGE for further details or to initiate a return. 
 Items with “Final Sale” in their name or description can not be returned, exchanged or refunded. 
 Items received in WTF Packs can not be returned or refunded. 
 We use a third-party service called Loop Returns to help process our returns. You can use it to exchange for any in-stock product or return for a refund.  
 I'M AN INTERNATIONAL CUSTOMER, HOW DO I MAKE A RETURN OR EXCHANGE? 
 For international returns please visit our RETURNS PAGE to get started. Unfortunately we do not cover the initial shipping, return shipping or custom fees on international orders. For customers looking for EU right of withdrawal, please visit our RETURNS PAGE . You can send the return to: Outlier Returns 125 Castle Road Secaucus, NJ 07094 USA 
 HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE FOR ME TO GET A REFUND? 
 We aim to process all returns as swiftly as possible. The goal is always to process it the day we receive it, but at times it may take up to a week. Once your return and refund has been processed, you’ll receive an email notification confirming the refund. The money is taken from our account immediately, but it may take a few days for it to show up on your credit card account. Each credit card company handles refunds differently so we can not give precise times on when you will get your money back. 
 CAN I DO A PARTIAL RETURN FOR ITEMS IN 3-PACKS OR PAIRINGS? 
 Yes, but you will only receive a partial refund. Any price-savings from the 3-Pack or Pairing will be voided and the sum effect is that you will wind up paying the full, non-3-Pack/non-Pairing, price for each of the items that you keep. You will be refunded for the difference between the original price paid and the full retail price of any items kept. 
 RESTOCKS 
 Restocks vary greatly from product to product. Core products tend to have major restock events every couple months, seasonal products once or twice a year. Experiments do not get restocked but if successful they might return as a regular product. 
 On any given product page you can sign up for restock notifications by clicking on the desired size/color and filling out the restock form that pops up. 
 Often the easiest and fastest way to find a sold out size or color is on the secondary market. We recommend visiting the r/OutlierMarket subreddit if you are interested. 
 GIFT CERTIFICATES 
 We do not currently sell gift certificates due to issues with fraud, but do offer them on occasion. Outlier reserves the right to review, reverse and cancel any gift certificate transactions, particularly those deemed fraudulent or suspicious. 
 REPAIRS 
 We do not offer any warranty or repair guarantees but if you are having any issues with how our products are functioning please contact our customer service at OUTLIER@OUTLIER.NYC and we will do our best to figure out a solution. 
 BULK BUY ELIGIBLE 
 HOW DOES THE BULK BUY WORK? 
 Please note this is a revised policy, in effect starting March 28, 2025 
 Bulk buy is designed for people who 1 - know what they want 2 - want to buy in bulk AND 3 - know they don’t want to return or exchange any of those items already. 
 When all these things line up, it saves us money and we are happy to pass these savings along to the customer. 
 Only products clearly noted as " Bulk buy eligible " are eligible for the bulk buy pricing. 
 When three (3) or more bulk buy eligible products are being purchased within a single order, the code NO-RETURNS-BULK-BUY-NO-RETURNS can be used to activate a 15% discount on the bulk buy eligible items. 
 Be very aware that by using the NO-RETURNS-BULK-BUY-NO-RETURNS code you are waiving the right to return or exchange any of the items which have their prices reduced.  
 They don’t need to be the same product though, you can mix and match! The key thing to remember is that only products labeled “ Bulk buy eligible ” count toward reaching the three item threshold and the price adjustment only applies towards bulk buy eligible products. 
 Bulk buy eligible products can NOT , under any circumstances, be applied across multiple smaller orders. 
 We reserve the right to ban for life or revoke return privileges from any customer who appears to be trying to gamify the system or otherwise use it in bad faith. We also reserve the right to ban for life, or revoke return privileges from, any customer who asks us to apply bulk prices across multiple orders, the whole point of a bulk buy is to consolidate things into one order!

TOAST.text:
Refund policy
 Returns
 Flat rate returns: USD 20.
 Our Standard Returns Policy
 Returning items purchased online - using our online returns service
 Full price items purchased online may be returned for a refund within 28 days of receiving them. Sale items purchased online may be returned for a refund within 14 days of receiving them.
 The following items cannot be returned:
 Pierced jewellery (eg. earrings) cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, unless faulty.
 Selected wellbeing items (eg. essential oil blends, tea infusions etc.) cannot be returned, unless faulty. This will be stated on the product page of the item when you purchase.
 TOAST Gift Cards and eGift Cards are also non-refundable.
 After placing an order you will receive order and delivery confirmation emails. We are no longer placing a returns label into our parcels.
 Visit returns.toa.st and enter your order number (you can find this located on your order and delivery confirmation emails) and your postcode or email address.
 Tick the items that you would like to return and tell us the reason.
 Choose collection or drop off. You can drop off your parcel at a UPS Drop Off Point in the United States or a DHL Service Point if outside the United States.
 You will need to pay the returns charge online that is applicable to your country.
 Print off the returns label (and customs declaration form if outside of the United States) and attach these to your parcel.
 Await your booked collection or drop off your parcel.
 Start a Return 
 If you are unable to print a label, please email us at contact@toa.st or call us on 18555 051384 (US toll free) or 0044 333 400 5200 (international charges apply) and one of our team will be happy to print the label and post it to you.
 We are no longer offering an exchange service for items. If you would like to change the size of your ordered garment, please call our customer services team who will be happy to arrange for a new item to be sent to you without any further delivery charges. You will need to pay for the new item and send the original item back to us for a refund, subject to our returns policy. Replacement garments are subject to stock availability.
 During busy periods, please allow up to 10 working days for your return to be processed once it is received into our warehouse. All refunds will be made to the original method of payment. Once a refund has been issued, please allow up to 5 working days for this to appear on your account.
 We offer a tracked returns service, so please keep the tracking number safe so you can quote it in any necessary correspondence.
All items must be returned in a fully resalable condition, which means being unused with swing tags attached and, if possible, in the original packaging. TOAST reserves the right to refuse a refund on items deemed not to be resalable. This does not affect your statutory rights in connection with faulty items.
 Returning items purchased online - to our shops
 You may also bring the items you would like to return to a TOAST shop in the United States, along with your order number. A member of our shop team will be pleased to process your refund. 
Full price items purchased online may be returned for a refund within 28 days of receiving them. Sale items purchased online may be returned for a refund within 14 days of receiving them.
All items must be returned in a fully resalable condition, which means being unused with swing tags attached and, if possible, in the original packaging. TOAST reserves the right to refuse a refund on items deemed not to be resalable. This does not affect your statutory rights in connection with faulty items.
 The following items cannot be returned:
 Pierced jewellery (eg. earrings) cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, unless faulty.
 Selected wellbeing items (eg. essential oil blends, tea infusions etc.) cannot be returned, unless faulty. This will be stated on the product page of the item when you purchase.
 TOAST Gift Cards and eGift Cards are also non-refundable.
 If you have any questions regarding returns to our shops, please contact our customer service team before you travel. Items cannot be returned to our shops if they were purchased from other websites or stores selling TOAST products.
 Returning items purchased in our shops in the United States
 Items can be returned to any TOAST shop in the United States.
 Full price items can be returned within 28 days of the purchase date for a refund or exchange.
All items must be returned in a fully resalable condition, which means being unused with swing tags attached. TOAST reserves the right to refuse a refund or exchange on items deemed not to be resalable. This does not affect your statutory rights in connection with faulty items.
 Pierced jewellery cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, unless faulty. TOAST Gift Cards and eGift Cards are also non-returnable.
It is not possible to use our online returns service for purchases made in our shops in the United States.
